title: Historic Agreement Reflects Trust Between UP and Confederated Tribes
summary: After almost two years of negotiations, Union Pacific and the Confederated Tribes of the Umatilla Indian Reservation (CTUIR) reach historical agreements regarding access to railroad land as well as a MOU on joint community policing.
